verifications.claim: Artemis II is a 10-day crewed flight test.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "The 10-day Artemis II mission will fly" (R5); "10-day mission" (R2, R6, R8, R9); "9 days, 1 hour, 32 minutes" approx 10 days (R3, R4)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state or approximate a 10-day duration for the crewed test flight.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's Orion spacecraft in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "testing the Orion spacecraft" (R1); "validate the Orion spacecraft's systems" (R3); "test flight of ... the Orion spacecraft" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly confirm validation/testing of Orion in deep space context.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate NASA's SLS rocket in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "first crewed flight of the Space Launch System (SLS)" (R3); SLS is launch vehicle, separates early (R5)
verifications.reasoning: SLS is tested during launch/ascent, not in deep space; Orion is the deep space vehicle.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is designed to validate life-support systems in deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5); "validate the life-support and environmental control systems" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Direct support for testing life-support in deep space.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "first crewed trip around the moon in more than 50 years" (R1); "first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm first crewed lunar mission since Apollo.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly four astronauts around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts aboard the Orion spacecraft" around moon (R1); "four astronauts toward space ... around the moon" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Consistent across sources.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's life-support systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "test essential life support systems aboard the spacecraft" (R3); "flight test Orion’s life-support systems with astronauts on board" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's environmental control systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "life support systems" including environmental (R3, R6); life-support encompasses environmental control (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Environmental control is part of life-support, but not always specified separately.

verifications.claim: Key objectives of the Artemis II mission include testing the Orion spacecraft's navigation systems with a crew on board.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "evaluate handling qualities ... using onboard navigation sensors" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Proximity operations and manual control test navigation.

verifications.claim: Artemis II sends four astronauts on a journey around the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "send four astronauts ... around the moon" (R1); "taking Mr. Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch and Jeremy Hansen on ... lunar round trip" (R2)
verifications.reasoning: Direct match.

verifications.claim: The four astronauts include the first woman to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Ms. Koch of NASA will be the first woman to do so" (R2); "Christina Koch the first woman" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Koch identified as first woman beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The four astronauts include the first person of color to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Glover of NASA will be the first Black man to venture into deep space" (R2); "Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Glover as first person of color/Black beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The four astronauts include the first Canadian to travel beyond low Earth orbit.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Mr. Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency will be the first person on a moon mission who is not an American" (R2); "Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Hansen as first Canadian beyond LEO.

verifications.claim: The journey around the Moon passes roughly 4,700 miles beyond it.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "within about 4,000 miles above the surface" (R2); "Closest approach ... 4,067 mi" (R3); "over 4,000 miles beyond the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources specify ~4,000-4,067 miles closest approach; 4,700 mismatches.

verifications.claim: Artemis II aims to fly humans farther into space than ever before.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "set a distance record for the farthest that any humans have traveled from Earth" (R2); "set the record for human distance from Earth" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly breaks distance record.

verifications.claim: Artemis II serves as a crucial test to prepare for Artemis III, IV, and future missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "lay the groundwork for future exploration" (R1); "clear a path for more exploration" (R2); "supporting subsequent Artemis missions" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Prepares for later Artemis missions.

verifications.claim: Artemis III, IV, and future missions will land humans back on the lunar surface.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "returning humans to the moon" (R1); "new lunar landing" (R2); "returning humans to the lunar surface" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Artemis III/IV plan lunar landings.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Commander Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander" (R2); "commander Reid Wiseman" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed across sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Pilot Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Victor Glover, who is scheduled to pilot" (R1); "Victor Glover, the Artemis II pilot" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Christina Koch" mission specialist (R3); listed as MS (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew includes Mission Specialist Jeremy Hansen
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Jeremy Hansen" mission specialist (R3); listed as MS (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Confirmed.
